benefit: Yarrow (Achillea millefolium) hosts predatory wasps, lady beetles, and lacewings that target codling moth eggs and aphid colonies. Drought-tolerant once established and tolerates orchard floor mowing.

members.title: Yarrow alley strip in orchard floor
members.body: Plant yarrow plugs 18 inches apart in a single row down the alley between fruit-tree rows. Mow at 6 inches once flowers brown.
